name: qlrisk_xva
title: XVA and CVA capital
description: Valuation adjustments and CVA capital. measure cva, dva, fva, kva, mva run qlrisk's calculators on an exposure profile ('total' sums them); 'sa_cva' (MAR50) and 'ba_cva' give CVA capital. cva inputs: ee_profile*, time_grid* (years), credit_spread_bp*, recovery_pct (* = required). Example: {"measure": "cva", "inputs": {"ee_profile": [400000, 600000, 700000, 650000, 500000], "time_grid": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], "credit_spread_bp": 100, "recovery_pct": 40}} gives CVA: 19,637.64 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
